policy.name: Uttarakhand Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Policy 2023

zones.A: Category A - all of Pithoragarh, Uttarkashi, Chamoli, Champawat, Rudraprayag, Bageshwar
zones.B: Category B - Almora, Pauri Garhwal, hill areas of Tehri Garhwal; Bhimtal, Dhari, Betalghat, Ramgarh, Okhalkanda blocks (Nainital); Chakrata block (Dehradun)
zones.C: Category C - plains of Tehri (Dhalwala, Tapovan, Muni ki Reti, Fakot plains); areas above 800 m in Raipur, Sahaspur, Vikasnagar, Kalsi, Doiwala (Dehradun) and Kotabagh (Nainital) blocks
zones.D: Category D - Haridwar, Udham Singh Nagar; Ramnagar and Haldwani blocks, Haldwani, Lalkuan, Ramnagar towns; Kotabagh up to 800 m; Dehradun Municipal Corporation and areas up to 800 m in Raipur, Sahaspur, Vikasnagar, Kalsi, Doiwala

zone_lookup: FAQ Q4 of the MSME Policy 2023: by district, development block and, in Dehradun and Nainital, height above sea level (800 m).

schemes.name: Capital subsidy (assistance on capital goods: workshop building, plant & machinery)
schemes.clause: Uttarakhand MSME Policy 2023 - official FAQs (Invest Uttarakhand), Q11-Q12, Q18
schemes.notes: Official FAQ table: Category A 50% of fixed capital investment up to Rs 1 crore (max Rs 50 lakh); above that Rs 50 lakh + 25% of the excess up to Rs 5 crore (max Rs 1.5 crore), Rs 1.5 crore + 20% up to Rs 10 crore (max Rs 2.5 crore), Rs 2.5 crore + 3.75% up to Rs 50 crore (max Rs 4 crore). B: 40/20/16/2.5% (max Rs 3 crore). C: 30/12.5/8/2% (max Rs 2 crore). D: 20/10/6/1.5% (max Rs 1.5 crore). Modelled as marginal slabs, which reproduce every stated maximum. New units and substantial expansion. Paid in 2 instalments (micro) or 5 (small, medium). Extra 5-10% for priority / most-priority sectors, anchor units and SC/ST/women/divyang owners (one only) is not modelled.

schemes.name: Interest subsidy on term loan
schemes.clause: Uttarakhand MSME Policy 2023 - official FAQs (Invest Uttarakhand), Q19-Q21
schemes.notes: Official FAQ: new units with a term loan for building and P&M; micro 4%, small 3%, medium 2% for 3 years from commercial production; yearly caps by area A-D: micro Rs 5/4/3/2 lakh, small Rs 6/5/4/3 lakh, medium Rs 7/6/5/4 lakh.

schemes.name: Electricity duty reimbursement
schemes.clause: Uttarakhand MSME Policy 2023 - official FAQs (Invest Uttarakhand), Q22-Q23
schemes.notes: Official FAQ: new units with sanctioned load up to 500 kW get electricity duty exemption for 5 years (FAQ does not state the share; taken as full exemption).

schemes.name: Quality certification reimbursement
schemes.clause: Uttarakhand MSME Policy 2023 - official FAQs (Invest Uttarakhand), Q33-Q35
schemes.notes: Official FAQ: 75% of the cost of ISO, ISI, BIS, FSSAI, ZED and similar certificates, up to Rs 1 lakh per unit; new units.

other_benefits: DPR assistance 75% of consultant fee up to Rs 1 lakh for new micro enterprises (secondary)
Mandi fee reimbursement 50% up to Rs 5 lakh/yr (A) / Rs 3 lakh/yr (B) for agri/horticulture processing (secondary)
Cluster CFC support up to Rs 5 crore (secondary)
